history_summary: Add three species-reference GTDB correspondences to the existing four-species lung model
history_details: The selected Rothia aeria, Neisseria cinerea and Streptococcus downei species-ID routes report reference populations 31/fraction 1.0, 80/fraction 0.98 and 2/fraction 1.0. The abstract does not identify study strains; no stock genome is assigned. Preserve Pseudomonas koreensis, the four-member composition, culture conditions, empty ecological graph and needs_research limitations. Only the three GTDB blocks/statuses and two native inline events change. Full scientific review, source-snippet coverage and corpus QC remain separate.
